div.head: Geþyncðo 5
div.ab: ⁊ gif þegen geþeah, þæt he wearð to eorle, þonne wæs he syððan eorlrihtes weorðe.
Et si tainus prouehatur ad consulatum, sit postea dignus rectitudine comitis et honore.
[61, 2] Et si liberalis homo ita ascendisset, ut comes fieret, habebat omnes rectitudines suas sicut comes.
And gif þegen geþeah þæt he wearð to eorle, þonne wæs he syððan eorlrihtes weorðe.
Und wenn ein Thegn emporstieg, dass er zum Grafen wurde, dann genoss er fortan Grafenberechtigung.
And if a thegn rose so that he became an earl, then he was henceforth entitled to earl-right.
[And if a thegn prospered, that he became an earl, then was he afterwards entitled to an earl’s rights.
And if a thane prospered so that he became a noble, he was afterward worthy of a noble’s rights.
div.note: Lacking in D (Liebermann marks no gap there).; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘…’).

note.seg: Überschrift De regis weregildo Lond (K Co Or); De weregildis singularum personarum cum Anglis MHk; fehlt Or R T
Heading De regis weregildo Lond (K Co Or); De weregildis singularum personarum cum Anglis MHk; missing in Or R T
Dass 5. 6 bereits archetyp und von D nur willkürlich fortgelassen sind, beweisen Inst und der zum Übrigen passende Stil.—Vgl. Gl Eorl 8; Thegn 9
That 5. 6 already stood in the archetype and were merely omitted arbitrarily by D is proved by Inst and by the style, which fits the rest.—Cf. Gl Eorl 8; Thegn 9
Offenbar weiss Verf. nichts von angeblichem Zusammenhang eines noch grösseren Grundbesitzes mit dieser Standeserhöhung, obwohl er doch die zum Thegn ans Landeigentum o. 2 anknüpft
Evidently the author knows nothing of any supposed connection of a still larger landholding with this elevation in rank, although he does link elevation to thegn with ownership of land above 2
Im privilegierten Schutz (s. d. Gl 14c. d) und Wergeld; s. d. Gl 10ff.
In privileged protection (see that word in Gl 14c. d) and wergild; see that word in Gl 10ff.
These chapters are only in Textus Roffensis.
